value.rationale: A structural all-path equivariant model identifies ordinary geometric reversal orbit spaces, not just rank, character or rational Betti numbers. It produces a first natural Z/2 homology class at path size 14 and arbitrarily many two-torsion homology degrees thereafter; such torsion is impossible in the unquotiented path spheres. The exact join classification is useful for understanding finite graph symmetries and integral orbit invariants beyond the historically known forest homotopy type.
